name: @galerina/devtools-hypha
description: Passive capability-map scanner for Galerina: extracts the compiler's dispatch surfaces, sentinel sets and checker wiring in memory and answers drift/coverage questions. No database, no build step, no dependencies — run it and it answers.
note: NO build step and NO dependencies, deliberately. This package ships runnable .mjs rather than TypeScript compiled to dist/, because a tool that needs `npm run build` before it can answer a question is not a passive scanner. It reads the compiler's dist/ JavaScript — what ships, which is also what runs. See README.md §Why this package breaks two house conventions.
